Provider cache E2E — verifies that Anthropic ephemeral cache markers actually produce cache_write_tokens on run 1 and cache_read_tokens on run 2 within the 5-minute TTL window. Uses claude-haiku-4-5 with a system message padded to ≥2048 chars so it crosses the haiku minimum cacheable prefix (~2k tokens). Two-step harness: trigger seeds an agent_session_id; run the SAME graph twice within 5 minutes — the second SSE should show extra_info.usage.cache_read_tokens > 0. Requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY + DATABASE_URL. Run twice in a row: ```
set -a; source .env; set +a
SESS=cache_test_$(date +%s)
./target/release/dag_engine run tests/graphs/agents/provider_cache_anthropic_e2e.json --agent-session-id $SESS --include-extra-info | tee /tmp/cache_run1.sse
./target/release/dag_engine run tests/graphs/agents/provider_cache_anthropic_e2e.json --agent-session-id $SESS --include-extra-info | tee /tmp/cache_run2.sse
grep -oE '"cache_(read|write)_tokens":[0-9]+' /tmp/cache_run1.sse /tmp/cache_run2.sse
```

Expected run1: cache_write_tokens > 0. Expected run2 (same SESS, within 5 min): cache_read_tokens > 0.
